verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, daily limits or session timeouts is a fair question for a government online filing service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack discloses any service-availability window, per-day limit or session timeout before a user starts. The only related item is the ability to continue a started registration, which is a different feature and is not a disclosure of time limits.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
